resources.string: The language applies to DRS apps instantly via per-app locales.
Themes are restricted to the contrast-verified variants in colors.md; a failing combination cannot be selected.
DRS Security Center is not installed on this device.
Shortcuts only open the apps/screens themselves; this app stores no data from them.
These preferences are stored locally in this app (v1). A shared policy store across DRS apps requires platform integration and comes later.
This system uses no artificial intelligence or machine learning — every decision is an explicit deterministic rule (policy ADR-0004).
Build details (build time and repository revision) are added by the build pipeline at platform integration; this standalone build shows the version only.
DRS OS is based on the Android Open Source Project (AOSP). Android is a trademark of Google LLC and is not part of DRS branding.
